Use case: stylized-concept. Production pixel-art UI material atlas for Hollow Choir, a quiet dark fantasy RPG. Exactly FOUR columns and FOUR rows on a square 1536x1536 RGBA canvas, each cell384x384. Every cell is a separate reusable UI ASSET, not a screenshot, no labels, text, numbers or icons. Flat straight-on orthographic view. Native coarse pixel-art clusters, crisp edges, no antialias, no photoreal leather or 3D perspective. Muted charcoal, peat, olive, worn dark brown leather, tarnished brass and bone. Interiors DARK and very quiet so ivory text reads well. Frames straight-edged with small crafted corners, modest stitching/bronze clasps, no huge ornament.
ROW1: (1) open satchel interior square panel: dark worn brown leather lining, stitched rolled leather rim and small corner brass rivets; (2) main menu panel: charcoal-green woven cloth inset, narrow aged bronze/wood border and restrained bone corner details; (3) inspection panel: soot-dark parchment/felt inset, fine bone-and-brass border; (4) local map background: muted dark olive parchment with faint paper grain, restrained faded botanical fen/reed texture along edges, blank open centre, no routes, symbols or writing.
ROW2: four square nine-slice button skins, all dark quiet central fills, frame along outer12percent only: (1) attack: weathered iron/brown leather trim, (2) technique: aged olive cloth with muted bronze trim, (3) utility/item: dark brown stitched leather trim, (4) focused/selected: matching richer bone-gold edge, no glowing bloom.
ROW3: (1) portrait socket frame, empty transparent middle, small bone/bronze fittings; (2) enemy-intent token frame, empty transparent middle, dark rust/bronze edging; (3) small numbered token frame with dark quiet middle and muted bone edge; (4) tooltip/description panel with charcoal cloth middle and fine stitched bone edging.
ROW4: (1) horizontal slider-track material, very dark recessed leather with narrow stitched edge, fills its square cell for nine slicing; (2) slider-filled-track material muted brass/olive woven leather, same shape; (3) round small brass-and-bone slider knob, isolated centered with transparent outside; (4) decorative header strip skin: dark textured cloth, small restrained brass corner flourishes, blank center.
Each rectangular PANEL/BUTTON fills its cell edge to edge with its own complete border. Borders are consistent along all four edges, designed for nine slicing: corner ornament only near corners, no large central illustration. Portrait/intent frames have genuine transparent central holes, knob transparent outside. No baked shadow outside cells, no checkerboard, no scenery, no mockup text, no watermark.

Use case: stylized-concept. Transparent pixel-art combat reaction UI asset atlas for Hollow Choir, a quiet dark-fantasy RPG. Exactly FOUR columns and FOUR rows, square1536x1536, cells384x384, no labels/grid/text. Coarse crisp pixel clusters, bone ivory, tarnished bronze, charcoal, olive, worn brown leather, very restrained muted red. Flat orthographic icons/materials, no lighting effects, blur or cast floor shadow. Every cell whole isolated asset centered within generous transparent gutter.
ROW1: (1) empty circular reaction dial ring made from aged bronze and carved bone, central hole genuinely transparent, no numbers; (2) same ring but warmer ivory inlay around whole rim for progress masking, central hole transparent; (3) a thin small ivory-bronze needle/pointer pointing UP, isolated; (4) short curved feather-like ivory impact marker.
ROW2: (1) circular BRACE medallion with a battered shield emblem, dark-leather center, bronze rim; (2) circular EVADE medallion with a pale swept feather/boot-motion emblem; (3) circular PARRY medallion with crossed weathered blade emblem; (4) selected medallion RIM only, bone-gold metal and leather stitches, transparent centre. All medallions consistent size/craft.
ROW3: (1) a wide horizontal dark leather timing-track frame with restrained bronze ends, completely blank center; (2) a wide horizontal timing-track fill of muted bone/olive weave, no frame; (3) tiny ivory timing cursor diamond; (4) a BROKEN state icon, cracked stone/bronze shield, no letters or blue lightning.
ROW4: (1) minimal broken-state plaque skin, dark rough leather with chipped bone/bronze edges, blank centre; (2) small round target token frame with transparent center; (3) parchment scroll-corner ornament with moss/bronze binding, isolated; (4) hollow traveller head marker, cream hood and simple bone oval mask with two black eyes and olive scarf, front view, no body, facing viewer.
No text, numbers, readable letters, arrows drawn as text, checkerboard, gradients, bloom, scenery or watermark. True transparent alpha outside each asset and inside empty rings. Every row stays on its exact equal cell grid.

Use case: stylized-concept. Production candidate neutral STANDING / BREATHING sprite sheet for Hollow Choir. Supplied image is CHARACTER IDENTITY reference only. Same cream hood, oval bone-white mask with two black eyeholes, olive scarf, charcoal/slate ragged coat, brown backpack, belt and boots. No sword drawn. Critical: a calm STANDING pose, feet planted CLOSE beneath hips, knees relaxed straight, both soles grounded at the same baseline. Absolutely no walking stride, stepping, crouch, legs spread or fighting stance.
Square1536x1536 RGBA, exactly FOUR columns by FOUR rows, cells384x384. Each character occupies about288px height and fits with wide transparent gutters, centered x192 in its cell, feet baseliney336. Crisp coarse pixel-art clusters, approximately32x48 native sprite enlarged6x, no antialias or smooth illustration.
Each PAIR of adjacent columns is the same facing in two tiny breathing states: frame1 neutral rest, frame2 minuscule chest/cloth inhale only. Identical planted feet, mask shape and position, hood, head, backpack, body scale and silhouette within each pair. Do not reposition or rotate the face in frame2.
ROW1: columns1-2 SOUTH toward viewer, columns3-4 NORTH away showing back of hood/backpack.
ROW2: columns1-2 WEST left, columns3-4 EAST right.
ROW3: columns1-2 SOUTHWEST, columns3-4 SOUTHEAST.
ROW4: columns1-2 NORTHWEST, columns3-4 NORTHEAST.
Warm near-black outlines, ivory/bone, muted olive, charcoal slate, brown, restrained brass. Tiny upper-left material highlights. Genuine alpha everywhere outside characters. No background, shadow, dust, ground, labels, grid, text or watermark. Keep the mask immutable and both boots resting together under the hips.
